programme.title: Gourmet Express
programme.desc: Hong Kong brings together global cuisines, and its unique dishes and down-to-earth fare have captured the close attention of discerning food lovers! Food hosts and presenters such as Icy Wong,Snowy Choi,Carmen Ngai,Carmaney Wong , Jessica Liu , Gillian Ng keep up with the latest food news and deals, delving into the stories behind the flavors. Gathering firsthand information on popular eateries across various platforms, the hosts personally line up and taste the food, providing genuine reviews. Even takeout-only eateries with no dine-in option are in high demandwhat are the must-try picks? Running a food business inevitably comes with its own mix of sweet, sour, bitter, and spicy experiences. The production team follows the proprietors through their busy day, from sourcing ingredients and preparing materials to opening for business, uncovering the stories behind the flavors.

programme.title: Vital Lifeline
programme.desc: Urban dwellers often experience a hectic pace of life and high levels of stress, making them more susceptible to health problems. The Strongest Lifeline helps you unravel the secrets to good health. To start, the program features a four-episode series on common urban pain issues, covering headaches, shoulder and neck pain, back pain, and joint pain. Each episode invites medical experts to explain the causes of these conditions, as well as physical therapists and exercise specialists to teach appropriate exercises. With the growing trend of integrating Eastern and Western medicine, even American swimming champion Michael Phelps uses cupping therapy to relieve pain. Therefore, each episode also includes traditional Chinese medical diagnosis, complemented by treatments such as acupuncture, cupping, and the Sanfu herbal patch therapy, which is especially suitable during the hottest days of summer. In addition, Chinese medicine practitioners share recipes for nourishing soups, all of which can help regulate and improve your health.

We even travel abroad to cover major entertainment events, track international movie stars, and conduct exclusive interviews with well-known singers, actors, and television personalities familiar to our audienceensuring you can instantly grasp the latest happenings and news in the world of film and entertainment.

programme.title: News Roundup

programme.title: Global View

programme.title: Big Boys Club
programme.desc: Big Boys Club is a youth talk show hosted by a group of close friendsBob Lam, Oscar Leung, Derek Wong, Philip Fan, and Alan Chan. In each episode, singers, entertainers, or guests from various fields are invited for relaxed interviews, presenting a wide range of topics including current social issues, pop culture, and trending interests. Matters of love, relationships, and even same-sex relationships are endlessly discussed topics for men and women alike. The show invites guests from diverse backgrounds to explore love and relationships, delving into the dynamics between the sexes. The Other Dimension segment features guests sharing extraordinary experiences, such as encounters with ghosts, UFOs, and bizarre happenings, bringing thrilling topics to the audience.

programme.title: Another Era
programme.desc: In 2008, as the tsunami of financial chaos engulfed the world, ambitious entrepreneur HO TIN-SANG Kwok Chun On saw the opportunity seeking to take over the richest man in Hong Kong, FONG CHUNG-YAMs Wu Fung business empire, but was interfered by another business magnate CHEUK KAI-TONG Pat Poon. Bearing animosity towards him, TIN-SANG has been seeking revenge since then. Ten years later, the now wealthiest Cheuk family is overshadowed by misfortune. The sudden death of KAI-TONGs son comes as a crushing blow to KAI-TONG, who lapses into a coma after a heart attack. To keep their business going, his inexperienced younger daughter CHEUK DING-YIU Chow Lai Ki, Niki, with the help of a private equity placement agent, KO CHIT Frankie Lam, faces off with TIN-SANG. With KAI-TONG regaining consciousness, TIN-SANGs wife CHEUNG MING-HEI Tavia Yeung, CHUNG-YAMs grandson FONG CHAK-YU Benjamin Yuen and aspiring young entrepreneur CHING HOI Chau Pak Ho also get involved in the ever-escalating power struggle. The enmity among them will soon intensify towards a full-blown rivalry

programme.title: Mrs. RevengeWhats On Today
programme.desc: Kind-hearted Hang-yu Samantha Ko suffers from some terminal illness as she just exists under the tyranny of her husband Sze Kai-wai Jonathan Cheung. She catches her husband having an affair with her only buddy Poon Suet-man Rosita Kwok, and while arguing, she is pushed into the road and tragically hit by a car. However, Hang-yu abruptly wakes up and realizes everything seems to be just a dream. But as the scenes in her dream come true one after another, she thinks this might be a premonition. To rewrite destiny, Hang-yu is determined to turn the bad luck around in her dream. Hang-yu not only wants to get rid of that scumbag and her fake buddy, but also tries to bring the two together so that Suet-man can take over her original misfortune. Moreover, she makes good use of her dream memories and undergoes a glamorous makeover to strive for success in the workplace. She also gradually develops romantic feelings for her boss Yip Ka-him Kenneth Ma, with whom she is fighting side by side, and eventually finds happiness!

programme.title: Like Mother, Like Daughter
programme.desc: Public relations queen TONG MAN-LEI Jinny Ng raises her Gen Z daughter TONG SUM Desta Lee alone and she is a control freak. MAN-LEIs mother, TONG CHO KA-BING Stephanie Che, has spent half of her life supporting her husband and raising their children. She is suddenly awakened and she returns to Hong Kong from Canada. She decides to reclaim her lost time and she moves into MAN-LEIs home. Many years ago, KA-BING and her daughter completely fell out because MAN-LEI insisted to have her daughter out of wedlock. Now, KA-BING suddenly breaks in without warning and disrupts MAN-LEIs life. MAN-LEI strives to maintain order, while TONG SUM mediates between the two, creating sparks and constant conflicts in this three-generation household. In the workplace, the wealthy heir, Marketing Guru YEUNG FAN Gary Chiu, is parachuted into the company to lock horns with MAN-LEI on equal footing. MAN-LEIs career and family are facing crises at the same time.

programme.title: Hipster Tour - South America Sr.2
programme.desc: Christy Leung restarts her South American journey, unlocking more Latin American countries and experiencing all four seasons in one trip! Stroll along Argentinas World Heritage glaciers and sample whiskey infused with glacial ice. Discover the idyllic paradise of Patagonia, enjoying its stunning scenery and delicious cuisine. Head to Easter Island in Chile, cycling around the island in search of giant stone statues. Explore the Amazon rainforest, the worlds largest tropical rainforest, with an adventure alongside the indigenous people. Visit the Galapagos Islands in Ecuador, famous for their evolutionary history, and explore their animal ecology. In Colombia, soak in a mud bath, swim in the Caribbean Sea, and visit a floating island in the middle of the ocean to witness the islanders lives.

programme.title: Story of Kunning Palace
programme.desc: Jiang Xue-ning Bai Lu went to great lengths to become the Empress. But she was forced to take her own life in the palace. Fast forward to the present, and Jiang Xue-nings wish is to stay away from power struggles and control her destiny. However, she still somehow enters the palace as a study partner and becomes Master Xie Weis Zhang Linghe pupil. While learning from Xie Wei, Jiang Xue-ning plots to prevent Yan Lin Zhou Junwei from getting involved in the coming-of-age incident. By following Jiang Xue-ning and Xie Weis strategy, the Yans manage to stay alive. After the coming-of-age crisis, Jiang Xue-ning unwittingly gets embroiled in the imperial court crackdown on Lord Pingnan rebels scheme. She and Zhang Zhe Wang Xingyue venture into enemy territory. At the critical moment, Jiang Xue-ning uses her body to shield arrows for Zhang Zhe. But the duo eventually cannot stay together. Hostile the State of Yue launches an invasion. First Princess Shen Zhi-yi Liu Xening does not hesitate to go down the road to making peace by marriage. To save her buddy Shen Zhi-yi, Jiang Xue-ning goes with Xie Wei to the north to deal with the State of Yue. While overcoming difficulties, Xie Wei does not mind getting hurt as he protects Jiang Xue-ning. The duo gradually have affectionate feelings for each other. However, an even more evil conspiracy gradually surfaces, and it astonishingly points to the truth about the Lord Pingnan incident from twenty years ago. Jiang Xue-ning and Xie Wei eventually team up to uncover the truth from yesteryear. Jiang Xue-ning also uses love to influence Xie Wei. The couple eventually find happiness.

programme.title: Big City Shop 2026
programme.desc: Big City Shop introduces viewers to a wide range of timely topics, including seasonal products, health and wellness, fitness activities, skincare and makeup, fashion apparel, infant care, parenting knowledge, local delicacies, and pet care trends. The content is all-encompassing! In addition to hands-on demonstrations, experiences, or tests by the hosts, experts are invited to share their professional insights. In the cooking segment, several skilled culinary experts take turns showcasing simple and delicious healthy dishes and home-style recipes, helping everyone solve their cooking challenges.

programme.title: Happy Old Buddies
programme.desc: Many people may think that older adults do not have sexual needs, but surveys have shown that this is not the caseolder adults often experience less sexual activity due to various reasons. Clinical psychologist Lin Haoming from the Social Welfare Department explains the World Health Organizations definition of sexuality and offers advice for those hoping to rekindle their sex life with their partner. However, if one partner does not wish to resume sexual activity, how should both sides communicate?

programme.title: Gourmet Express
programme.desc: Hong Kong brings together global cuisines, and its unique dishes and down-to-earth fare have captured the close attention of discerning food lovers! Food hosts and presenters such as Icy Wong,Snowy Choi,Carmen Ngai,Carmaney Wong , Jessica Liu , Gillian Ng keep up with the latest food news and deals, delving into the stories behind the flavors. Gathering firsthand information on popular eateries across various platforms, the hosts personally line up and taste the food, providing genuine reviews. Even takeout-only eateries with no dine-in option are in high demandwhat are the must-try picks? Running a food business inevitably comes with its own mix of sweet, sour, bitter, and spicy experiences. The production team follows the proprietors through their busy day, from sourcing ingredients and preparing materials to opening for business, uncovering the stories behind the flavors.

Veteran childrens program hosts Tam Yuk-ying, Lai Chi-shan, and Gai Sai-bo have also grown up alongside you! Each episode will feature a different theme, inviting hosts from different eras to reunite and reminisce about the past. Decades have passed, and the young hosts and participants of yesteryear have all grown up considerably. The hosts have gone out of their way to find these people and relive those memorable moments with everyone. The classic segment Soaring Through the Air holds countless happy memories. The hosts and guest Ali Lee will guide a new generation of children through the fun.

The show will also feature a variety of childrens songs, allowing kids to sing along while learning practical life knowledge.

programme.title: Forgotten Valley, The
programme.desc: Highly influenced by western culture, couple LUK SHUI-FUNG Raymond Wong and LAW KWAI-SZE Grace Chan want to reshape their feudal hometown, Ping On Valley, which has fallen so far behind, but nothing comes out as they wish. Not only are they under the tyrannical dictatorship of their father, Village Chief LUK KAM-KUK Lau Kong, who constantly stands in their way, but they are also involved in the ghost bride murder mystery, kidnapping and homicide respectively. Victims of bullying including KAM-KUKs concubines SUNG MING-FUNG Louisa So and KOO MAN-YEE Rebecca Zhu, and maid TIN CHOR-YAT Katy Kung eventually cant take it anymore. Defying the status quo in the fight for gender equality, they secretly form an alliance to protect other girls who fall victim to this. Unexpectedly, a group of wicked guys headed by butler NG SHEUNG-SHUN Louis Yuen bring in bandits for their own selfish motives. While blowing the girls cover, it also puts the relationship of SHUI-FUNG and KWAI-SZE to the test, escalating the feud between men and women

programme.title: Scam Alert!
programme.desc: The number of various scams continues to rise, with the amounts involved becoming increasingly staggering. It is reported that Hong Kong suffers an average daily loss of HK25 million, with a scam occurring every 13 minutes Scams targeting online shopping, job seeking, investment, dating apps, and telephone scams are becoming increasingly sophisticated. Citizens must raise their awareness of scams and be vigilant to avoid falling victim! Hosts Au Wing-Kuen, Edwin Siu, Lee Man-Fong, and Leung Man-Hau gather various real-life cases to gain a deeper understanding of how victims were scammed. The program will also recreate these scenarios in story form. Experts will appear to dissect different methods of committing these crimes, helping viewers identify money-grabbing traps and avoid becoming targets of scammers!

programme.title: Midlife, Sing Shine! 4
programme.desc: Midlife, Sing Shine! 4 has officially launched, continuing the success of the previous three seasons and once again providing a stage for singing enthusiasts to pursue their dreams. This season expands its recruitment efforts to North America and Australia, with several TVB artists participating masked, igniting the flame of music globally and illuminating the hearts of countless dreamers. Stephanie Che continues to host, offering her warm smile to the contestants Maria Cordero, Chow Kwok-fung, Cheung Ka-tim, Hai-er, and Gu Ya-wei also serve as judges, providing professional feedback and encouragement to the participants. On this new seasons stage, everyone will weave an even more moving chapter with music, continuing the heartfelt story of Midlife, Sing Shine! 4.

programme.title: Once A Thief
programme.desc: Put Chai Ko Chow Yun-fat, Jim Leslie Cheung, and Red Bean Cherie Chung are all orphans who become international thieves under the tutelage of their adoptive father Kenneth Tsang. By chance, Put Chai Ko, Jim, and Red Bean learn the whereabouts of a stolen masterpiece, The Maid of Herring, from a Paris museum. Put Chai Ko, determined to complete his mission and retire to marry his girlfriend Red Bean, perishes in a fire during a mission. Years later, Red Bean marries Jim, who has always secretly loved her. Just when she thinks she can finally live a peaceful life, Put Chai Ko suddenly reappears, revealing that theres more to the story...

programme.title: Hong Kong: Never Too Small
programme.desc: Amidst the ebb and flow of time, local shops that depict the microcosm of the city are becoming increasingly rare. Yet, they are a vital part of the citys structure and an irreplaceable embodiment of the Hong Kong spirit. With this in mind, the down-to-earth host, Louis Yuen, leads viewers on a shop-by-shop exploration, visiting time-honored and modern shops across four key areas of daily life: clothing, food, housing, and transportation. He reveals the shops operating history, the hardships of maintaining them, and the stories behind generations, using these tangible shops to preserve intangible memories and showcasing the enduring beauty of small spaces.

programme.title: Music Money Monster
programme.desc: Pushing the limits of vocal range and precise timing, the brand-new interactive music game show Music Money Monster is hosted by Sammy, Eric Kwok, and Lee Yin-tung. A professional pitch analysis system tests the contestants. A nine-square grid represents nine difficulty levels. Contestants who connect three lines to pass the level can choose to withdraw their winnings, continue the challenge, or even attempt the most difficult Monster level. Failure results in zero prize money! The amateur version allows solo participants to compete for a top prize of NT100,000. The celebrity version offers viewers a chance to win prizes and gifts by interacting with the contestants in the live stream and sending emojis to cheer them on.

programme.title: J Music 2026
programme.desc: J Music is dedicated to creating a high-quality music platform, providing singers with opportunities to showcase their musical talents while allowing music fans to gain a deeper understanding of their musical stories. The program invites popular singers as guests, who personally select their favorite new and old works, perform them live, and share their favorite tracks. New faces in the music scene will also appear, showcasing their musical potential through interactive exchanges. Furthermore, each episode closely follows the latest developments on the Jade Solid Gold Chart, featuring music videos and interviews with various singers, songwriters, and producers, who discuss their work and the people and events within the music industry.

programme.title: You Are Not Alone Again
programme.desc: You Are Not Alone triumphantly returns! With a world full of mysteries, the program gathers paranormal news from around the globe, and Chi Yan will travel to South Korea and Taiwan to explore local supernatural phenomena. programme.title: Gao Xing De Suan Tian Ku La
programme.desc: Set in a rapidly changing Beijing, optimistic small-town dreamer Chang Gao Xing meets local girl Li Sasa. Despite their contrasting backgrounds, the two bond as they face career failures, financial struggles, and personal heartbreak togetherultimately finding love, maturity, and a place to call home.

programme.title: The Sound of Happiness
programme.desc: Wu is a senior police officer has always wanted a son to carry his family name and join the force. However, he and wife are bequeathed with four daughters! As a doting father, his chief objective is to help them find happiness in their marriages. In this charming drama, Wu his wife become their daughters greatest haven, through the ups and downs they face as married women.

programme.title: The Tradition Story of Taiwan

programme.title: Hot Door Night
programme.desc: Different in age, generation, and hosting style, these three hosts not only can sing, act, dance, and imitate, but are also skilled in cross-talk! With this unique combination, we hope to attract viewers of all ages and spark great entertainment.

programme.title: Stylish Man-The Chef
programme.desc: Stylish Man The Chef is co-hosted by the Golden Bell Awards winner Sam Tseng and Genie Chuo, together with professional chef, James. There are two main themes for the program, which are Big Stars Come to Cook and Five-Star Cooking Show. Stylish Man The Chef containing not only the bomb of laughter, but the audience can also gain practical cooking knowledge throughout the program.

programme.title: New Taiwan Is Online
programme.desc: In a media landscape flooded with misinformation, this current affairs programme cuts through the noise with sharp analysis and investigative reporting. Hosted by Lee Cheng Hao, the show uncovers hidden issues and speaks up for the people, delivering clarity and accountability in every episode.

programme.title: Blessing of Formosa
programme.desc: The beauty of folklore is all around us in Taiwan, but we often overlook it and fail to appreciate and feel it. The aim of this program is to promote the beauty of Taiwanese folklore and bring folklore to life. This program showcases folk culture regardless of race or religion, and presents travel information in a fun way, combining easy-to-understand folk culture knowledge with the mission of passing on folk culture. The audience can learn more about folk cultural products such as handicrafts, antiques, temple folklore, as well as short stories about the gods, and information about local tourism. It is an educational and entertaining way to travel and learn about folklore.

programme.title: Venus Online
programme.desc: Venus Online is a vibrant lifestyle and beauty show featuring the latest in makeup, skincare, and fashion. Each episode shares practical tips and fun challenges that inspire confidence and celebrate personal style.

programme.title: Girls Tease
programme.desc: This show focuses on the issues that are most important to urban modern women. It combines current events with discussions of lifes major and minor problems and invites various specialists to address various difficulties. Netizens will occasionally attend the show to share their own stories and ask questions of the guests and experts, making the topics more relevant and audience-focused!

programme.title: Top Singers
programme.desc: The show Top Singers aims to spotlight outstanding Taiwanese singers and composers, setting a new standard in the industry. Combining elements of competition, variety, and personal stories, the show welcomes participants of all ages. Its goals include discovering grassroots talent, innovating Taiwanese song performance styles, and involving more local talent in song composition to infuse new life into Taiwanese music.

programme.title: Show Biz
programme.desc: Every second counts in Show Biz to bring you with the most High Speed star news, exciting live shows and performers interviews.

programme.title: Love, Now
programme.desc: Lan Shi De, who lost his first love in college, reunites with Yang Yi Ru in a foreign land. When he learns she has only six months to live, he decides to marry her and fulfill her dream wedding. Eight days later, she mysteriously disappears, and Shi De vows not to let true love slip away again.

programme.title: The Moon Thieves
programme.desc: A crooked watch dealer assembles a daring crew - a thief, an explosive expert, a lock breaker and a watch connoisseur - to steal three luxury watches in Tokyo. Their mission takes an unexpected turn when they discover the legendary Moonwatch. Pursued by the yakuza, the team must unite to navigate the chaos and pull off their high-stakes heist.

programme.title: 77 Heartwarmings
programme.desc: After breaking up with Adam, Eva focuses on her career but Adam still wants to make up and tries to move her 77 times. Things become more complicated when a Thai movie idol courts Eva. It is at this time that Evas mother becomes very ill, and she considers marriage in order to fulfil her mothers wish. Will Adam succeed in warming Evas heart?

programme.title: Tristar
programme.desc: Young priest Hong disguises himself to protect Bai, a prostitute, while Detective Liu investigates her ties to a prostitution ring. Hong finds Bai a lawful job and helps her negotiate with the underworld. Meanwhile, Lius investigation causes misunderstandings - can he crack down on the gang? How will Hong manage his emotions as Bai falls for him?

programme.title: Death Notice
programme.desc: A serial killer leaves death notices in a city, stating when, how and who he will murder. Even if the victims report it to the police and receive protection, the killer can still break through and execute them. While the police sets up a special task force in response, they expose an even bigger conspiracy behind.

programme.title: One More Chance
programme.desc: A gambling-addicted Fai is entrusted by his ex-girlfriend to care for their autistic son. What begins as a chaotic father-son relationship gradually becomes a journey of mutual redemption, helping him rediscover himself. When he discovers his sons talent for running, Fai resolves to leave the past behind and support his son in pursuing his dreams.

programme.title: Cliff Walkers
programme.desc: The first spy thriller movie by famous Director Zhang Yi Mou, this film follows four Communist Party special agents who embark on a secret operation in the Japanese puppet state of Manchukuo in 1932. Sold out by a traitor, the agents, who split up into two teams, find themselves surrounded by threats on all sides. Can they complete their mission?

programme.title: Table for Six
programme.desc: In this comedy, three brothers reside in a home inherited from their late parents. The eldest brother insists they have dinner at home every night as a family, but tensions begin to rise when their girlfriends join in as well. Love, friendship, jealousy and complicated relationships are all on the menu for this table for six!

programme.title: Tiger Wolf Rabbit
programme.desc: Three devastated parents, pushed to the edge by the abduction of their children, forge a fierce alliance in the barren deserts. Driven by fury and grief, they embark on a lawless, violent crusade to hunt down a brutal trafficking syndicate. Can they shatter the criminal ring and bring their children home alive?

programme.title: The Last Dance
programme.desc: Amid the recession caused by the pandemic, debt-ridden wedding planner, Sheng, finds a lifeline as he transitions into a funeral planner. His unconventional approach leads to unexpected success, and his attitude toward his career and life is transformed after being inspired by the respected Master Wen.

programme.title: Lelio PoPo
programme.desc: Former radio DJs KK and Ah Luke were once hugely popular, but their bad attitudes and eccentric behaviour got them fired. Desperate for a comeback, they audition for a new radio station searching for elderly female hosts. Disguising themselves as old ladies, the pair unexpectedly land the job and spark a series of hilarious misadventures.

programme.title: High Forces
programme.desc: On its maiden flight, an A380 airliner is hijacked by armed gunmen. Among the passengers is international security expert Gao Hao Jun, whose daughter has been taken hostage, putting her life in grave danger. Determined to save her, Gao confronts the hijackers head-on. Can he rescue all the passengers and thwart the crisis?

programme.title: The Hedgehog
programme.desc: Wangs odd behaviour and quirky ideas make him a social outcast. His teenage nephew Zhou, who is ashamed of his stutter, becomes Wangs only friend. Together, these misfits challenge traditional family expectations and social misunderstandings, supporting and inspiring each other as they seek their own paths in life.

programme.title: Kung Fu Hustle
programme.desc: Mobster Sing aspires to join the Axe Gang. As he stumbles into a slum ruled by eccentric landlords that are kung fu masters in disguise, his actions cause the gang and the landlords to engage in an explosive kung fu battle

programme.title: Confinement
programme.desc: Si Ling, a pregnant painter, moves into her dream home after winning an award and hires a confinement nanny. As she begins her one-month confinement after giving birth to her daughter, inexplicable incidents start happening in the house, threatening both her and her baby

programme.title: An Abandoned Team
programme.desc: Uncle Jia is bad-tempered and lives alone. His forced retirement, failed marriage and strained relationship with his daughter have left him in despair, prompting him to consider ending his life. Fortunately, he is rescued by a stray dog and an animal welfare volunteer, allowing him to rediscover his purpose in life.

programme.title: Ready OR Knot
programme.desc: Guy and Heidi have been together for five years since they first met in a wedding banquet, but marriage soon becomes a challenge to their relationship. Heidi sees marriage as a testimony of their love, while Guy sees it as doomsday. Can the couple resolve their conflict? Are they ready or not?

programme.title: Rob N Roll
programme.desc: A ruthless bandit, Tian, has plotted an intense and quick armed robbery. When he encounters Hui and Shui who also plan for a robbery, they decide to team up for the heist. However, their ad-hoc and dramatic robbery has started a war with the police hot on pursuit, putting their lives on the line!

programme.title: Cloudy Mountain
programme.desc: When a decade-long tunnel project is about to complete, an earthquake strikes and leads to a series of subsidence and landslides. The tunnel and a nearby town are at stake. A retired soldier and his son step up to try and stop the disasters at source. Will the authority decide to blow up the tunnel to save the 160,000 people in town?

programme.title: Wish Comes True
programme.desc: Xiao Fei is a cheerful girl who has been abandoned by her mother. One day, she encounters a gifted young man named Zi Wai, who is battling a rare disease. Determined to help him, she embarks on a journey to find his lost love. Even when they discover that the drug treating Wai is ineffective, they choose to embrace hope and love together.

programme.title: Dust To Dust
programme.desc: Back in 1995, the Police successfully arrested five armed bank robbers while the two masterminds got tipped off and made a clean escape. Decades later, retired cop Wang Shou Yue is drawn back to the unsolved case when he sees a blurred figure in a news clip. A battle between good and evil has just begun!

programme.title: We are Family
programme.desc: Struggling as an extra, Chi Kwong joins a rent-a-family company run by Carlos and aspiring actress Catherine, and rent themselves out as make-believe relatives. As they surrogate different families, they unravel the complexities of family relationships, forging deeper connections along the way.

programme.title: The Brotherhood Of Rebel
programme.desc: Chai, a triad member, helps his childhood friend Meow flee Hong Kong after discovering that Meow attempted to kill his triad boss. 17 years later, Chai becomes a key member of the triad. When he runs into Meow one day, he knows that his gang will kill Meow if they find him. Caught between triad and brotherhood, what will Chai choose?

programme.title: Leap
programme.desc: At the 2008 Beijing Olympics, former volleyball legend Lang Ping shocked China by coaching Team USA to victory against her home nation. Years later, when Chinas womens volleyball team fell into a slump, she returned to rebuild the squad and eventually led them to a historic gold medal triumph at the Rio 2016 Olympics.

programme.title: The Magic Blade
programme.desc: The movie depicts Fu Hong Xue fighting against the formidable conspirator Master Yu and seeing through his deception. The brilliantly choreographed fights, glorious settings, superb cinematography and strong casts define this movie as a highpoint in Wu Xia cinema.

programme.title: Empress Wu
programme.desc: Wu Ze Tian is a beautiful and talented concubine of Emperor Tang at age 14. She becomes a nun after he died but has two sons with the new Emperor Tang Gao Zong. The Empress asks Wu to team up with her against Consort Xiao, but is set up and dethroned by Wu, who also kills her two sons. After the Emperors death, Wu becomes the first woman Emperor.

programme.title: Disco Bumpkins
programme.desc: This musical comedy is about how a young man Fen, along with his buddy Hamburger, finds love and success in the advertising world.

programme.title: The Millionaire Chase
programme.desc: Its a fun and wild romp that mixes pleasure with pleasure. A nightclub owner, playboy Peter Chen Ho, has his ways with three sisters while gallivanting across Asia. Each one has a dangling relationship to save - ensuring a series of mishaps and comic moments.

programme.title: Four Riders
programme.desc: Four martial arts experts live in Seoul after the Korean War in the 1950s. One of them inexplicably crosses path with a drug trafficking syndicate, and his three friends have no choice but to fight a brutal battle on his side...

programme.title: The Emperor and the Minister
programme.desc: The ingenious imperial scholar Liu Yung always embarrasses Emperor Chien Lung with his quick wit and gift of gab. The emperor purposely sets him up to solve the seemingly unsolvable. However, Liu Yung resolves it easily with wit and style and foils the emperors plot once again.

programme.title: Little Hero
programme.desc: An orphan, Little Bastard is taken on and trained as a fighter by a hermit. When Little Bastard grows up, he feels he is old enough to go out and look for his parents. Luckily for him, he befriends a beggar, Hsiao Yi, who being street-wise, manages to help him find his family, but somehow gets into trouble with the gang.

programme.title: The Love Eterne
programme.desc: Ying Tai disguises herself as a boy to attend school and falls in love with her classmate, Shan Bo. After discovering her true identity, Shan Bo proposes marriage, only to learn that Ying Tai has been promised to another man. Forced apart, Shan Bo dies in despair. Devastated by the news, Ying Tai kills herself at his grave.

programme.title: The Pirate
programme.desc: Pirate Chang Pao Chai discovers a leak in his ship after a successful raid on a foreign merchant ship. He goes ashore to get materials to patch up his ship, but encounters corrupt Qing officials oppressing the poor peasants. A good man at heart, he decides to help the peasants and gain a reputation of being a great pirate in the process.

programme.title: My Dream Boat
programme.desc: This is a story about the complicated love relationships between a group of young friends who are entangled in a web of love and emotions.

programme.title: The Brave Archer 3
programme.desc: Guo Jing and Huang Rong go to Iron Palm Peak to search for the Book of Wumu. The chief of Iron Palm discovers their visit, and seriously injures Huang. It seems only the Southern Emperor Duan can heal her, but will Huang be healed in time?

programme.title: The Magnificent Concubine
programme.desc: Yang Gui Fei is the beloved concubine of Emperor Tang Ming Huang, who is so besotted with her that he leaves the running of the country to Prime Minister Yang Guo Zhong, the brother of Yang Gui Fei. The Prime Minister is corrupt and cruel to the army, causing them to revolt and endanger the throne. Yang Gui Fei is also implicated and kills herself.

programme.title: Descendant of the Sun
programme.desc: Shi Sheng is adopted by an old carpenter and grows up to possess extraordinary superpowers. One day, he unexpectedly discovers his identity as the son of the solar deity and learns that his power will be lost during solar eclipse. When an evil spirit appears and wreaks havoc, Shi Sheng must beat him in an ultimate duel to save the world.

programme.title: The Happy Trio
programme.desc: Ah Chiao, a village girl stranded in the city, befriends a kind-hearted tramp and a retired actor. They are poor but happy, though Ah Chiaos fortune change for the better when she becomes a singer. However, she soon learns that money cannot buy one happiness...

programme.title: The Gambling Syndicate
programme.desc: A young provincial detective seeks to take down a local gambling syndicate with the help of two convicts.

programme.title: Intimate Confessions of a Chinese Courtesan
programme.desc: Young Ai Nu is abducted and sold to the popular Four Seasons brothel run by the powerful and ruthless Madam Chun Yi. Ai Nu gets locked up in a dungeon due to her fiery attitude. Soon, a murder occurs within the brothel and a policeman must race against time to prevent a vicious revenge plot from reaching its blood-spattered conclusion.

programme.title: King Drummer
programme.desc: A young musician Chi Chiang is hired by the manager of a popular band when the groups drummerleader Charlie, quits to join a rival group. The new drummer becomes an immediate hit, causing Charlie to be very jealous. Furthermore, the young drummers mother is dead set against him having a music career.

programme.title: Shaolin Temple
programme.desc: As more people are learning martial arts from Shaolin, the Qing court orders for it to be banned and plans to destroy the temple. The Shaolin disciples decide to take their protest to the streets, using Shaolin skills to curb their hatred, but when the Qing troops start attacking Shaolin Temple, the disciples vow to protect it at all costs.

programme.title: Boxer Rebellion
programme.desc: The Empress Dowager Cixi believes the Boxers claim that they have developed a kung fu that makes them impervious to weapons, thus declaring war against the alliances of eight foreign nations. The lack of weapons and good leadership in the Ching government allows the Eight Nation Alliances to take down Beijing.

programme.title: Men From The Monastery
programme.desc: At the end of the Ming Dynasty, Wu San Gui betrays his people by siding with the Qing and recruiting fighters from all backgrounds. Members of the Wudang and Emei sects are among the first to surrender and collude with local bullies. When they attack the Shaolin Monastery, its renowned disciples must unite to fight their enemies.

programme.title: Puppy Love
programme.desc: To the tune of the Osmonds hit song, this is a story of adolescent playfulness innocence lost. Two best friends grow up together and teasingly meet two delightfully impish boys leading to the four to flirtatiously intermingle. However, the innocence of partner swapping eventually leads to a roller-coaster bouts of misunderstood emotions.

programme.title: Heaven and Hell
programme.desc: When an angel, Ling, decides to help his two friends who have fallen in love to escape from Heaven, he is sent to live as a human on earth as his punishment. Reincarnated as a cab driver, he sacrifices his own life to save another ill-fated couple and lands in hell, where he has to face off against the ghosts and demons to fight his way out!

programme.title: A Friend From Inner Space
programme.desc: A young boy whose parents are separated tries to find happiness in life. One day, he meets and befriends a kind-hearted spirit Ren, who decides to make him truly happy by getting his parents back together.

programme.title: The Trail of the Broken Blade
programme.desc: After avenging his fathers death by assassinating a high official, Li Yue disappears into hiding as a fugitive. His fiance enlists a swordsmanwho secretly loves herto search for him, unaware that the bandit Xiao Mei has also fallen for Li Yue. Their intertwined love quadrangle explores themes of sacrifice, devotion and selfless love.

programme.title: My Son
programme.desc: Kuo, a polices son, blames his father for his mothers death. He has no job, spends time in night clubs and always gets into fights. One night, Kuo rescues Mei from being raped and they become friends. Kuo wants to support Mei and her family so he goes gambling hoping to gain more money but bad luck seems to be following them with tragic outcomes.

programme.title: Full Moon Scimitar
programme.desc: Swordsman Ding fought against many swordsmen and won, so he took his first defeat badly and wanted to commit suicide. It is then that he meets the granddaughter of a mystic Sect leader and falls in love. When they want to get married, the Sect leader presents Ding with the Full Moon Scimitar, on the condition that he will never leave the sect.

programme.title: Mohini
programme.desc: Vaishnavi and Sandeep, an engaged couple, face chaos when Vaishnavi is possessed by a vengeful lookalike, threatening their relationship and future.

programme.title: Free Ticket
programme.desc: The host presents a curated compilation of hit songs and memorable snippets from the most popular and trending Tamil movies, celebrating the best of Tamil cinema.

programme.title: Virupaksha
programme.desc: When a man visits his ancestral village, where terror reigns after a chain of unexplained deaths, he must unravel mystical secrets before its too late.

programme.title: Vadacurry
programme.desc: Sathish, who is ashamed of his cheap phone, gives in to temptation when he finds one lying unattended in a shop and steals it. Unfortunately for him, the phone belongs to someone dangerous.

programme.title: August 16 1947
programme.desc: Amid Indias independence celebration, the news fails to reach Sengadu, a remote village oppressed by Robert Clive. Param rises to lead the liberation of the villagers.

programme.title: Yaamirukka Bayamey
programme.desc: Kiran, a telemarketer, renovates a mansion into a hotel with the help of Sharath. However, things take an unexpected turn when his customers die and Kiran realises that the hotel is haunted.

programme.title: Irandam Ulagaporin Kadaisi Gundu
programme.desc: Selvam hopes to buy his own lorry and marry his lover Chittu. However, his dreams are disrupted when he ends up with an unexploded bomb.

programme.title: Yagavarayinum Naa Kaakka
programme.desc: Yaagavaraayinum Naa Kakka is a genuine, properly sketched tale of friendship, love, hatred and possessiveness with Aadhi, Mithun Chakraborthy and Nikki Galrani in the lead roles.

programme.title: Rajamahal
programme.desc: Rudra, a mentalist and a medium, helps track down a ghost that is haunting a resort.

programme.title: Rekka
programme.desc: A young man, known for helping couples elope, is forced by a gangster to kidnap a politicians daughter after he stops the wedding of a girl who didnt want to marry him.

programme.title: Enna Solla Pogiraai
programme.desc: Vikram, a young man, plans to make his fiancee fall in love with him. However, when his plan backfires, he finds himself embroiled in a love triangle.

programme.title: When I was Your Age
programme.desc: Paul, 10, is a typical little boy. He goes to school, he plays sports, he is secretly in love, he tries to do as little as possible at home, he confuses his parents to get what he wants. And most of all, he would like them to finally understand that hes not a baby anymore and is old enough to do things ON HIS OWN!Except that... he has a strange gift... or curse... As soon as someone says the words, When I was your age... Paul is immediately hurled back to the time when the person he is talking to was 10 years old like he is now. He can shoot back 20, 30...70 years in time! Before mobile phones existed... When boys and girls didnt go to the same school... When there was only one television station... When toilets were at the far end of the yard... In other words, for a boy in 2021: ancient history! So as soon as he hears, When I was your age, gasp, gulp, where and when will he land this time? And in what completely crazy situation?

programme.desc: 流汗是人的自然調節機制，但流汗異常地多，有機會導致身體內平衡和免疫系統失調西醫如何治療異常多汗的情況?中醫認為流汗的類型及體質息息相關，如何固攝汗液，避免處於體虛狀態?今集杏林在線，受訪的七十二歲翟先生，原本少流汗，直至兩年前切除了前列腺後，便開始異常多汗，影響社交和工作，及後找中醫調理身體在中醫角度，流汗及臟腑功能有關，在正常情況下，仍不斷流汗是自汗基督教聯合那打素社康服務註冊中醫師蕭滙謙：中醫認為心主血脈，汗為心液，我們的心氣能推動血液循環做完手術大傷元氣，很多時候行兩步樓梯發覺會氣喘和泄汗少做運動的人，一般來說氣血比較差，身體會出現陰虛的情況，陰虛很容易制不住身體的火，便會有內熱不同部位流汗也反映身體狀況，中醫會作講解在西醫角度一個人是否有體臭，排汗多與少，很大程度跟遺傳有關如果止汗劑也無法有效控制多汗的情況，醫生說可以考慮在多汗位置，注射肉毒桿菌毒素針劑香港整形及整容外科醫學會委員麥忻華：我們出汗的時候，神經末梢是去接收這些訊息，肉毒桿菌針其實便是封鎖了這個訊息，令到我們沒有出汗的信號，所以減退出汗通常我們也會在腋下和手掌，每六個月左右要做一次治療醫生亦會視乎多汗個案的嚴重性，決定是否為病人做手術

programme.title: YTN 24
